newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NAB says fin services sales rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NAB says fin services sales rise.

text.p: MELBOURNE, Nov 11 (Reuuter) - National Australia Bank Ltd said on Monday sales of its financial services products rose 38 percent to a record A$2.6 billion in the year to September 30.
National Australia Bank said the sales figure included A$1.0 billion in sales from its National Australia Financial Management products, a 44 percent increase on the previous year.
Sales were assisted by strong growth in sales of wholesale financial services.
Wholesale investment fund applications, primarily to National Australia Asset Management, rose by 160 percent to A$490.3 million in the year to September 30 1996.

National's general manager, personal financial services, Trevor Matthews said in a statement that while maintaining sales growth through the financial planning network was a priority, there was still great potential to increase sales through alternative distribution channels.
At 12.15 p.m. (0115 GMT), National's shares were three cents lower at A$13.74.
